title: Jimmy Carter's UFO briefing confirmed by Alonzo McDonald
place_text: Oval Office, White House, Washington DC

tellings.quote: but I know that Alonzo McDonald confirmed to several of us that um and our group during that era, the OAP era, that uh he talked to the staff that attended that briefing. He talked to Carter and it happened.

plain: President Jimmy Carter got a briefing on UFOs in the Oval Office in 1977, and a man named Alonzo McDonald confirmed it, saying he had spoken to the staff who attended and to Carter himself, and that it happened. The scientist Eric W. Davis tells this, repeating what McDonald told him and others in his research group, and points to a June 1977 list of attendees kept by Carter's presidential library. If true, a sitting president was told about UFOs.
